mentions.name: deckd
mentions.description: A generic desktop controller that runs on any device as a web app/PWA (no app store needed), letting users turn a phone or other device into a dynamic Stream Deck-style control surface. It provides mouse, keyboard, and media controls, supports custom button types plus sliders and color pickers, dynamically switches layouts based on the foreground app, and can also switch which app is in the foreground from the controller. Planned features include deeper app integration and an e-ink version.
mentions.problem: The Stream Deck inspired it, but the author wanted a more dynamic interface with fewer hardware restrictions.
